1181: You have given us soul, breath of life and body.
Infusing Your light within, You make the foolish beautiful.
All are beggars; You, O God, are merciful.
Chanting the Name, they are enraptured. ॥1॥
O my Beloved, You are all-powerful, the Cause of causes;
ਹਉ ਪਾਵਉ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ; ਸਗਲ ਥੋਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
from You I receive everything. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Chanting the Name, one is saved.
Chanting the Name, one finds sublime peace and poise.
Chanting the Name, one obtains honour and glory.
Chanting the Name, no obstacle blocks the way. ॥2॥
For the sake of which this precious human body was given,
bless me with that Word, O my God.
May this mind find rest in the company of the holy;
ਸਦਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
may I ever chant Your Name in my heart, O God. ॥3॥
Without You there is no other;
ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਖੇਲੁ; ਤੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
all is Your play, and all merge back into You.
As it pleases You, save me;
Nanak, peace is found by meeting the perfect Guru. ॥4॥4॥
My Beloved God, my King, is with me;
beholding Him, I live, O my mother.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਦੁਖੁ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Remembering Him in meditation, there is no pain;
be merciful and lead me to meet Him. ॥1॥
O my Beloved, support of my breath and mind,
ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ; ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਧਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
this soul and breath are all Your wealth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ; ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
He is sought by angelic beings and gods;
ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਖ; ਨ ਲਹਹਿ ਭੇਵ ॥
the silent sages and Shesh-naag do not know His mystery;
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
His state and extent cannot be described;
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ; ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
He pervades each and every heart. ॥2॥
His devotees are filled with bliss;
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ; ਨਾਹੀ ਖੈ ॥
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ; ਨਾਹੀ ਭੈ ॥
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਜੈ ॥੩॥
What praise of You can I utter?
God, the Giver of peace, is all-pervading.
be merciful and bless me with Your Name. ॥4॥5॥
As plants turn green on receiving water,
so in the company of the holy ego is dispelled.
As a servant is encouraged by his master,
so the Guru, the Pir, is the means of salvation. ॥1॥
You are the Great Giver, O God, the Bestower;
each moment I bow to Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who enters the company of the holy —
that humble being is imbued with the love of the transcendent Lord.
His devotees worship Him; this is the way of union. ॥2॥
My eyes are content, beholding His sight;
my tongue sings His infinite praises;
my thirst is quenched by the Guru's grace;
my mind is satisfied with the taste of the Lord's essence. ॥3॥
Your servant is committed to serving Your feet,
Your Name is the saviour of all;
You are the Great Giver; You keep on giving.
You pervade my soul and my breath of life.
You have given me all sorts of foods to eat;
ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ; ਇਕੁ ਗੁਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨ ॥੧॥
I am unworthy; I have not recognised even one of Your gifts. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਜਾਨਉ; ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
I do not understand anything of Your worth;
1182: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
save me, O merciful God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾਪ ਨ ਤਾਪ; ਨ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਤਿ ॥
I have not practised meditation, austerity or good deeds;
I do not know any religious rites.
Within my mind I hold one hope:
that by the support of Your Name I shall cross over. ॥2॥
You are perfect in all powers, O God;
the fish in the water cannot find its limits.
You are inaccessible, unfathomable, the highest of the high;
I am small, and You are so very great. ॥3॥
Those who meditate on You are rich;
those who have found You are wealthy;
those who serve You are at peace;
Nanak, they seek the sanctuary of the saints. ॥4॥7॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਿ; ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ॥
Serve the One who fashioned you;
worship the One who gave you life.
ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚਾਕਰੁ ਹੋਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਡਾਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Become His servant, and you shall never again be punished;
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਪੋਤਦਾਰੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
become His trustee, and you shall never again suffer sorrow. ॥1॥
The mortal who is blessed with such great good fortune
ਸੋ ਪਾਏ; ਇਹੁ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
attains this state of nirvana. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Life is wasted in serving another;
ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ; ਪੂਰਨ ਅਰਥਾ ॥
serving the holy is ever joyful. ॥2॥
If you long for eternal peace, O brother,
the Guru has shown you to join the company of the holy.
There, only the Name is chanted;
in the company of the holy, you shall cross over. ॥3॥
Of all essences, this is the essence of wisdom;
of all meditations, meditation on the One is the most sublime;
the kirtan of the Lord's praises is the highest melody;
Nanak, meeting the Guru, sing His praises. ॥4॥8॥
Chanting His Name, the mouth becomes pure;
meditating in remembrance on Him, one's reputation becomes stainless;
ਜਿਸੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ; ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੁ. ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
worshipping Him, one is not tortured by the Messenger of Death;
ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
Chant the Lord's Name, Ram Ram, Ram Ram;
ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ; ਸਗਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
abandon all the desires of your mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He is the support of the earth and the sky;
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
His light illumines each and every heart;
remembering Him, even sinners are sanctified;
ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ. ਨ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
in the end, they will not weep again and again. ॥2॥
Among all religions, this is the most sublime;
of all rituals and conduct, this is above all;
ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਹਿ; ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
the angels and gods long for Him;
commit yourself to serving the society of the saints. ॥3॥
One whom the Primal Lord blesses with this gift
obtains the treasure of the Lord;
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
his state and extent cannot be described;
servant Nanak meditates on the Lord, Har Har. ॥4॥9॥
My mind and body are gripped by thirst and desire;
the merciful Guru has fulfilled my hopes.
In the company of the holy, all my sins have been erased;
I chant the Name, imbued with love of the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
By the Guru's grace, spring has come.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I enshrine the Lord's lotus feet within my heart; forever and ever I listen to the Lord's praise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
1183: O all-powerful Lord and Master, Cause of causes,
I am an orphan; I seek Your sanctuary, God.
All beings and creatures depend on Your support;
be merciful, God, and save them. ॥2॥
O divine Destroyer of the cycle of births and of pain,
ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
the angelic beings and silent sages serve You;
ਧਰਣਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
the earth and sky are in Your power;
all beings eat what You give. ॥3॥
bless Your slave with Your glance of grace.
Be merciful and bless me with this gift,
that Nanak may live by chanting Your Name. ॥4॥10॥
In the love of the Lord, all sins are taken away;
chanting the Lord's Name, there is no suffering at all.
Meditating on the Lord of the universe, all darkness is dispelled;
remembering the Lord, the cycle of reincarnation ends. ॥1॥
Spring is within me, the love of the Lord;
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ; ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am ever in the company of the saints. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The saints have shared this teaching:
ਜਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤੁ; ਸੋ ਧੰਨਿ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
blessed is the land where the devotee of the Lord of the universe dwells.
A place without devotion to the Lord is a wilderness;
by the Guru's grace, recognise the Lord in each and every heart. ॥2॥
Let the kirtan of the Lord's praises be your enjoyment of pleasures;
ਮਨ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ; ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
O mind, ever hesitate to commit sin.
Behold God the Creator near at hand;
here and hereafter, God resolves your affairs. ॥3॥
My meditation is focused on the Lord's lotus feet;
in His mercy, God has blessed me with this gift.
ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ; ਬਾਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
I long for the dust of the feet of Your saints;
Nanak meditates on the Lord and Master, ever present. ॥4॥11॥
The True transcendent Lord is ever new;
by the Guru's grace, I chant His Name continually.
God is my protector, my mother and father;
remembering Him, there is no suffering. ॥1॥
ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ; ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ॥
I meditate on my Master with single-minded love;
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I ever seek the sanctuary of the perfect Guru; the True Master has hugged me close. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
God Himself protects His humble servants;
the wicked demons have grown weary of wandering against them.
Without the True Guru there is no place of rest;
those who run from land to land find only pain. ॥2॥
Their past deeds cannot be erased;
they eat what they themselves have sown.
The Lord Himself is the protector of His humble servant;
ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਪਹੁਚਿ. ਨ ਸਕਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
no one can rival His servant. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ; ਕਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
God Himself protects His slaves with His own effort;
His glory is unbroken and perfect.
Sing the praises of the Lord of the universe ever with your tongue;
Nanak lives by meditating on the Lord's feet. ॥4॥12॥
Serving the Guru's feet, pain is gone;
the transcendent Lord God has shown mercy;
all desires and tasks are fulfilled;
Nanak lives by chanting the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਸਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Beautiful is that season when the Lord comes to mind;
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਂਤੀ; ਸਾਕਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
without the True Guru the world is seen weeping; the faithless keep coming and going. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
1184: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
They alone are wealthy who have the Lord God as their capital;
through the Guru's Word, lust and anger are destroyed;
their fears are dispelled, and they attain the fearless state;
meeting the Guru, Nanak has meditated on his Master. ॥2॥
God has made His dwelling in the company of the holy;
ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ; ਹੋਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ॥
chanting the Lord again and again, hopes are fulfilled.
He pervades water, land and sky;
ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੩॥
meeting the Guru, Nanak chants the Lord, Har Har. ॥3॥
The eight supernatural powers and the nine treasures are this Name;
by His grace it is obtained by one to whom He gives the Name.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ; ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
Your slaves live by chanting and meditating on You, O God;
Nanak, meeting the Guru, the heart-lotus blossoms. ॥4॥13॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Meditating on Him, all desires are fulfilled;
God has united those long separated from Him. ॥1॥
Dwell on the Lord of the universe, who is worthy of contemplation,
ਜਿਤੁ ਰਵਿਐ; ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਭੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
contemplating whom one enjoys peace and poise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In His mercy He has blessed me with His glance;
He Himself has taken care of His slave. ॥2॥
My bed has become beautiful in His love;
God, the Master of peace, has come to meet me. ॥3॥
He did not consider my merits or demerits;
Singing His praises, sins are destroyed;
night and day the melody of poise wells up. ॥1॥
My mind blossoms forth at the Lord's feet;
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਭੇਟੇ; ਨਿਤ ਰਾਤੌ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in His mercy I have met the holy, and I am ever imbued with the love of the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In His mercy, the Lord of the world has revealed Himself;
attaching me to His hem, the Merciful Lord of the meek has saved me. ॥2॥
This mind has become the dust of the holy;
it ever sees the Master present. ॥3॥
Lust, anger and craving are gone;
God Himself has cured the disease;
He has protected His children, placing His hand on their heads. ॥1॥
Tranquillity and poise fill my home; it is always spring.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ; ਕਲਿਆਣ ਰੂਪ. ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have entered the sanctuary of the perfect Guru, chanting the mantra of the Lord, Har Har, the embodiment of bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
God Himself has dispelled sorrow and suffering;
ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ; ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
meditate on your Guru, continually, continually. ॥2॥
The humble being who chants Your Name
ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ; ਨਿਹਚਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੩॥
obtains all fruits, singing Your eternal praises. ॥3॥
Nanak, beautiful is the way of the devotees:
they meditate continually on the Giver of peace. ॥4॥3॥16॥
By His command He has made them enraptured;
He has become merciful to His servant. ॥1॥
The perfect Guru has made everything perfect;
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He has implanted the nectar Name in my heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
He did not consider my deeds or my faith;
1185: taking me by the arm, He carried me across the terrifying world-ocean. ॥2॥
God has washed off the filth and made them pure,
those who seek the sanctuary of the perfect Guru. ॥3॥
You Yourself act; You Yourself are the Creator;
in Your mercy, You have saved Nanak. ॥4॥4॥17॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
See — the flowers are blossoming, blossoming!
grasp hold of the lotus feet;
remember the Lord, O my mind. ॥ Rahao ॥
The trees are dense with shade, fragrant and tender,
yet some remain dry like hard wood.
The season of spring has come;
Now the time has come, O mind:
sow the seed of the one Name, sow it.
There is no other season for it, none at all;
do not be misled by doubt, do not be misled.
Meeting the Guru, one finds the Lord,
if such destiny is written on one's forehead.
O mind, this is the season of the Name;
ਗੁਨ ਕਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੮॥
Nanak utters the praises of the Lord, Har Hare, Har Hare. ॥2॥18॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹੋਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ. ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Come together and meet, O my brothers; dispel duality and be lovingly attuned to the Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਜੋੜੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਸਫਾ ਵਿਛਾਇ ॥੧॥
Be partners in the game of the Lord's Name; as Guru-facing, spread out your mat and sit down. ॥1॥
In this way, throw the dice, O brother:
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ. ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
as Guru-facing, chant the Name day and night, and at the end you shall suffer no pain. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਤੁਮੑ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਸਾਜਹੁ; ਸਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Make good deeds and righteousness your game-board, and truthful living your pieces.
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜੀਤਹੁ; ਐਸੀ ਖੇਲ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
Conquer lust, anger, greed and attachment; such a game is dear to the Lord. ॥2॥
ਉਠਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਭਾਤੇ; ਸੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥
Rise in the early hours and take your bath; even while sleeping, worship the Lord.
ਬਿਖੜੇ ਦਾਉ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ; ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
My True Guru carries one through the difficult moves, and one goes home in peace and poise. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੈ. ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖੈ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
The Lord Himself plays and Himself watches; the Lord Himself fashioned the creation.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਖੇਲੈ; ਸੋ ਜਿਣਿ ਬਾਜੀ. ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
Servant Nanak, one who plays this game as Guru-facing wins the game and goes home. ॥4॥1॥19॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ. ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਅਉਰੁ. ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
You alone know Your creative power; no one else knows it.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਸੋਈ ਤੁਝੈ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
Only one to whom You show mercy, my Beloved, recognises You. ॥1॥
I am a sacrifice to Your devotees.
ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ; ਰੰਗ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your place is eternally beautiful, God; Your wonders are infinite. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ. ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ; ਅਉਰੁ. ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Only You can bring about service to You; no one else can do it.

One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace

He Himself is the congregation, uniting friends. ॥1॥
O bumblebee, take in such a fragrance
that the trees flower and the forests turn green. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He Himself is Lakshmi, and He Himself her husband;
establishing the world by His Word, He Himself enjoys it. ॥2॥
He Himself is the calf, the cow and the milk;
He Himself is the temple, the pillar and the body. ॥3॥
He Himself is the deed and the doer;
You, the Creator, create and watch over Your creation;
You give the support of Your light to countless beings. ॥5॥
You are the lake and the ocean, deep in virtue;
You are without lineage, immaculate, the supreme diamond. ॥6॥
You Yourself are the Creator, able to do all;
O King, You are pure; Your people are at peace. ॥7॥
Nanak, one is satisfied by the taste of the Lord's Name;
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਜਨਮੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੮॥੭॥
without the Lord and the Beloved Guru, life is wasted. ॥8॥7॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਨਉ ਸਤ ਚਉਦਹ ਤੀਨਿ ਚਾਰਿ; ਕਰਿ ਮਹਲਤਿ, ਚਾਰਿ ਬਹਾਲੀ ॥
Nine regions, seven continents, fourteen worlds, three realms and four ages You made, and You settled the mansion through the four sources of creation.
ਚਾਰੇ ਦੀਵੇ. ਚਹੁ ਹਥਿ ਦੀਏ; ਏਕਾ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
You placed the four lamps in the hands of the four ages, each in its turn. ॥1॥
ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਮਾਧੌ; ਐਸੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Merciful Lord, Destroyer of demons, Master of Maya — such is Your power. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਲਸਕਰੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀ ॥
Your light in each and every home is Your army, and the Righteous Judge rules over it.
ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇਗ ਮਿਲੈ ਇਕ ਵੇਰਾ; ਭਾਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
The earth is a cooking pot given once and for all; destiny is Your storekeeper. ॥2॥
ਨਾ ਸਾਬੂਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ, ਫਿਰਿ ਮੰਗੈ; ਨਾਰਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
The mind is not content and keeps asking again; the restless Narad brings disgrace.
